title: Reducing QPU Calls in Variational Quantum Algorithms via Classical Offloading of Gradient Computation
abstract: arXiv:2503.16361v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) are a promising approach for leveraging near-term quantum computers, but trainability and quantum-resource costs remain major challenges. Here we address these challenges with the \textbf{H}ardware \textbf{E}fficient and dynamical \textbf{LI}e algebra supported \textbf{A}nsatz (HELIA) and two training methods combining the classical-enhanced \g method with the quantum-based Parameter-Shift Rule (PSR). This distributes gradient estimation and training across classical and quantum hardware. We evaluate ground-state estimation of 6- to 18-qubit Hamiltonians using the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) and quantum phase classification for Hamiltonians up to 12 qubits. For VQE, our methods improve accuracy and success rates, with a mean reduction in estimated logical quantum evaluations of up to $60\%$ relative to Full-PSR training of the same ansatz. translated_title: 通过梯度计算的经典卸载减少变分量子算法中的QPU调用次数
translated_abstract: 变分量子算法（VQAs）是利用近期量子计算机的一种有前景的方法，但其可训练性和量子资源成本仍然是主要挑战。本文通过硬件高效且动态李代数支持的拟设（HELIA）以及两种将经典增强梯度方法与基于量子的参数移位规则（PSR）相结合的训练方法来解决这些挑战。该方法将梯度估计和训练过程分布在经典和量子硬件上。我们使用变分量子本征求解器（VQE）评估了6到18量子比特哈密顿量的基态估计问题，以及最多12量子比特哈密顿量的量子相分类问题。对于VQE，我们的方法提高了精度和成功率，与相同拟设的Full-PSR训练相比，估计的逻辑量子评估次数平均减少高达60%。对于分类任务，最大的改进……
tldr: 本文提出HELIA拟设及结合经典增强梯度方法与参数移位规则的混合训练方法，将梯度计算部分卸载到经典硬件，使VQE的逻辑量子评估次数平均减少高达60%，同时提升精度和成功率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the HELIA ansatz and hybrid training methods combining classical-enhanced gradient computation with the Parameter-Shift Rule, offloading gradient computation to classical hardware and reducing logical quantum evaluations by up to 60% for VQE while improving accuracy and success rates.
